h: Supporters reportedly carrying sticks and cutlasses arrive for Tinubu's campaign flag-off in Kaduna
p: Some APC supporters were reportedly seen holding sticks and cutlasses as crowds streamed into Ranchers Bees Stadium in Kaduna for the flag-off of President Tinubu's re-election campaign. Many others arrived in party caps and T-shirts, carrying posters of the president. Footage of the arrivals has drawn concern online about safety at campaign events.
more: The Kaduna rally is the first major stop of the APC's 2027 campaign tour.
The party has not commented on the reports of supporters carrying weapons.
Port Harcourt is reportedly the next stop on the campaign trail.
alt: Crowds in party caps and T-shirts, some holding APC posters, arrive at a stadium in Kaduna
